# Find the cancel-by date and the bad clauses before a SaaS contract renews itself.

> Free SaaS and vendor contract reader: paste an agreement and get the auto-renewal cancel-by date (downloadable .ics), the price steps and what a missed deadline commits you to, plus the clauses buyers push back on, such as list-price renewals, uncapped liability and one-way indemnity. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
